QuestInfo.name: The Man of Convention
QuestInfo.0: #b#p1012109##k seems to catch on to something here. I'll need to hear this.
QuestInfo.1:
He said #p9120011#'s doll that is laden with #t4000144# may be controlled by something. I can't just stand still listening to this! I'll have to gather up #b50 #t04000148#s#k from #b#o7130300##k, as well as #b50 #t04000147#s#k from #b#o7130010##k. 
Since #p9120011# is crying, I'll have to return #b#t04000147##k to her first and hand #b#t04000147##k to her, then go to where #b#p1012109##k is.

#t04000148# #b#c04000148##k/50
#t04000147# #b#c04000147##k/50
QuestInfo.2: After handing #b#t04000147##k to #p9120011#, a blinding light engulfed the dolls, and then they transformed back to their original state. Too bad #b#t04000148##k disappeared in the process. What should I do? I better go talk to #b#p9120011##k.

0.0: So the doll moved by itself... MAYBE, just maybe, the #b#t4000144##k that ran away may have attached itself to the doll.
0.1: That doll, plus the #b#t4000144##k that I've been looking for, I'm sure they both went returned to Eos Tower. No, in fact, they both might be controlled again. I think the monster has an ability to control the spirits.
0.2: Please, can you head over to Eos Tower and take #b50 #t04000148#s#k from #b#o7130300##k, as well as #b50 #t04000147#s#k from #b#o7130010##k? If you gather those up, maybe that kid's doll, as well as the #b#t4000144##k that ran away from me, may well be recovered.

yes.0: Thank you. Once you gather them all up, please go see #b#p9120011##k first. You can see me after her. Good luck.

no.0: I see. I can't really put you in this much danger. If you can recommend this to someone near you, can you tell me who that might be?

1.0: Hey, did you find my doll?
1.1: (The moment I handed #p9120011# #b50 #t04000147#s#k, they were surrounded by a blinding light, followed by their transformation back to a regular doll!)
1.2: Ah, my eyes! Huh, hey... my... my doll! Wow! It's that very doll my dad gave me! It's baaack!
1.3: (Whoa, the #b#t04000148##k that I had with me also disappeared! What... what should I do?)
1.4: Thank you so much for finding it! I'll give you this for your job well done. I don't know if this is useful to you or not, but... please put it to good use!

npc.0: Head over to Eos Tower and take #b50 #t04000148#s#k from #b#o7130300##k, as well as #b50 #t04000147#s#k from #b#o7130010##k? Once you get them all, please go visit #b#p9120011##k first.

item.0: Did you find my doll? If not, then please ask #b#p1012109##k of Henesys if he can figure something out.
